entities.summary: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmad Babar Sidhu NI(M)  HJ HI(M) SI(M) TI(M) is a Pakistani military officer who is currently serving as the Chief of Air Staff of the Pakistan Air Force, in office since 19 March 2021. On 19 March 2021, Babar took over command of the Pakistan Air Force from his predecessor ACM Mujahid Anwar Khan.
